svg.title: Hello, stalker — Kavya
svg.desc: Glitching headline 'HELLO, STALKER.' beside an animated neural network. Signals travel from the query 'what if…' to three outputs: bug, feature and why. A ticker lists AI/ML, RAG, backend, computer vision and accessibility.
